Fundamentals (PE, EPS, revenue, margins, etc.) for the given symbol. Every field describes the newest filing except three. `pe_ratio` is computed from a full year of net income: `pe_basis` says whether that year came from a trailing-twelve-month filing (`ttm`), an annual one (`annual`), or, only when neither is available, four times the newest quarter (`quarterly_x4`). `annual_net_income_period` names the period it used, for example `FY 2025`. `operating_cash_flow` comes from the newest filing that carries a cash flow statement, which is not always the newest filing, and `operating_cash_flow_period` names that period. Gate on `pe_basis` if a `quarterly_x4` estimate is not good enough for your screen.
